expressionSupportCompositionLemma.quantifier: Every exact registered expression-partial family whose complete nested capture audit passes, at every stored derivative order where that original leaf is defined.
expressionSupportCompositionLemma.proof: The original defining body depends only on the formal coordinates in its independently computed free-coordinate set. Every defined partial derivative is a limit of difference quotients of that body or its preceding derivatives; these quotients and their limit cannot introduce any absent formal coordinate. After simultaneous capture-free application, only actual arguments corresponding to active formal coordinates can vary the leaf. This is induction over the stored derivative sequence, not commutation of mixed derivatives.

stageA.firstAbsentInputLemmaProof: The original leaf's complete actual argument tuple and capture audit determine all varying coordinates. If the FIRST ordered differentiation coordinate is absent, the function on its existing domain is constant in that coordinate, so that derivative and derivatives of its zero result are zero. A later absent coordinate cannot erase an unproved earlier derivative.

allOrderFamilyLemma.quantifier: For every original capture-verified source application f and every integer n>=1, every ordered derivative word whose FIRST coordinate is absent from all actual inputs has value zero wherever that original leaf is defined on an open domain.
allOrderFamilyLemma.recurrence: D_absent f=0; D_j(0)=0 for every subsequent independent direction j; induction proves every word length n.

expressionSupportCompositionLemma.quantifier: Every exact registered expression-partial family whose complete nested capture audit passes, at every stored derivative order where that original leaf is defined.
expressionSupportCompositionLemma.proof: The original defining body depends only on the formal coordinates in its independently computed free-coordinate set. Every defined partial derivative is a limit of difference quotients of that body or its preceding derivatives; these quotients and their limit cannot introduce any absent formal coordinate. After simultaneous capture-free application, only actual arguments corresponding to active formal coordinates can vary the leaf. This is induction over the stored derivative sequence, not commutation of mixed derivatives.

stageA.firstAbsentInputLemmaProof: The original leaf's complete actual argument tuple and capture audit determine all varying coordinates. If the FIRST ordered differentiation coordinate is absent, the function on its existing domain is constant in that coordinate, so that derivative and derivatives of its zero result are zero. A later absent coordinate cannot erase an unproved earlier derivative.

allOrderFamilyLemma.quantifier: For every original capture-verified source application f and every integer n>=1, every ordered derivative word whose FIRST coordinate is absent from all actual inputs has value zero wherever that original leaf is defined on an open domain.
allOrderFamilyLemma.recurrence: D_absent f=0; D_j(0)=0 for every subsequent independent direction j; induction proves every word length n.

expressionSupportCompositionLemma.quantifier: Every exact registered expression-partial family whose complete nested capture audit passes, at every stored derivative order where that original leaf is defined.
expressionSupportCompositionLemma.proof: The original defining body depends only on the formal coordinates in its independently computed free-coordinate set. Every defined partial derivative is a limit of difference quotients of that body or its preceding derivatives; these quotients and their limit cannot introduce any absent formal coordinate. After simultaneous capture-free application, only actual arguments corresponding to active formal coordinates can vary the leaf. This is induction over the stored derivative sequence, not commutation of mixed derivatives.

stageA.firstAbsentInputLemmaProof: The original leaf's complete actual argument tuple and capture audit determine all varying coordinates. If the FIRST ordered differentiation coordinate is absent, the function on its existing domain is constant in that coordinate, so that derivative and derivatives of its zero result are zero. A later absent coordinate cannot erase an unproved earlier derivative.

allOrderFamilyLemma.quantifier: For every original capture-verified source application f and every integer n>=1, every ordered derivative word whose FIRST coordinate is absent from all actual inputs has value zero wherever that original leaf is defined on an open domain.
allOrderFamilyLemma.recurrence: D_absent f=0; D_j(0)=0 for every subsequent independent direction j; induction proves every word length n.

expressionSupportCompositionLemma.quantifier: Every exact registered expression-partial family whose complete nested capture audit passes, at every stored derivative order where that original leaf is defined.
expressionSupportCompositionLemma.proof: The original defining body depends only on the formal coordinates in its independently computed free-coordinate set. Every defined partial derivative is a limit of difference quotients of that body or its preceding derivatives; these quotients and their limit cannot introduce any absent formal coordinate. After simultaneous capture-free application, only actual arguments corresponding to active formal coordinates can vary the leaf. This is induction over the stored derivative sequence, not commutation of mixed derivatives.

stageA.firstAbsentInputLemmaProof: The original leaf's complete actual argument tuple and capture audit determine all varying coordinates. If the FIRST ordered differentiation coordinate is absent, the function on its existing domain is constant in that coordinate, so that derivative and derivatives of its zero result are zero. A later absent coordinate cannot erase an unproved earlier derivative.

allOrderFamilyLemma.quantifier: For every original capture-verified source application f and every integer n>=1, every ordered derivative word whose FIRST coordinate is absent from all actual inputs has value zero wherever that original leaf is defined on an open domain.
allOrderFamilyLemma.recurrence: D_absent f=0; D_j(0)=0 for every subsequent independent direction j; induction proves every word length n.

allOrderProof.induction: Differentiate the displayed exact X^-a eta^b H^(m) recurrence; its two chain derivatives are -2(1-eta²)/X² and -4eta/X. Dominated convergence supplies every fixed H derivative on Z>=0. The recurrence and norm triangle inequality therefore hold for arbitrary nonnegative p,q, not only computed rows.
allOrderProof.norm: |D_X^p D_eta^q H| <= sum_(m,a,b) abs(c_pq[m,a,b])*4^-a*(hmax)_m*(1+hmax)_m, uniformly for X>=4, abs(eta)<=1.
allOrderProof.improperTail: Gamma(1+h)>exp(-2)>1/9. For t>=L>=1, t^(h+m)<=t^(m+1). Integer incomplete gamma integration by parts gives the exported exact rational tail; no omitted tail is assigned zero.
allOrderProof.allOrderCutoff: L=64*(m+bits+1)^2. For L>=2*(m+1), incomplete-gamma tail <=18*m!*2^-L*L^(m+1). Bound m!<=2^(m²), log2 L<=6+2*(m+bits+1). The remaining exponent margin is the positive polynomial 61m²+126m*bits+118m+64bits²+125bits+51.
allOrderProof.mixedTail: Sum absolute chain coefficients; reserve r=bit_length(sum abs c). L=64*(p+q+bits+r+1)^2 encloses every constituent derivative tail by 2^-(bits+r), hence the entire mixed remainder by 2^-bits.
allOrderProof.GaussianTail: If a>0, a*N>=1 and a*N²>=p, the ratio (ell+1)^p exp(-a(ell+1)²)/(ell^p exp(-a ell²)) <=exp(-aN)<1/2 for ell>=N. Thus sum_(ell>=N) ell^p exp(-a ell²) <=2*N^p exp(-aN²). Controls use rational a; actual original Gaussian amplitude/derivative domination remains a premise.
